summary: Centerra Gold filed a Form 6-K attaching a Q2 2026 press release. The company reported that its Board approved up to $200 million in share buybacks for 2026, having completed $50 million in Q2. The press release also notes strong operational performance, increased production guidance, extension of credit facility to $600M, and progress on project developments. This is a foreign private issuer report; the share repurchase program is the sole special-situation element, qualifying as a capital return. No other special situation (e.g., acquisition, activist, restructuring) is indicated. Terms: $200M program authorization, with $50M executed in Q2. Watch for execution pace and any market impact.
